body:
HUMAN DECISION (2026-10-03 ~11:30 local, recorded as D14 in PLAN.md section 10): every repository has CI/CD in GitHub Actions.

Guide: docs/guidance/ci-cd.md (commit ed1d314). Section 2 lists the two required workflows: ci.yml runs the check gate on every pull request with no branch filter, because the GitHub mirror lands changes as stacked pull requests (D13), and on push to main. cd.yml builds the jar and the image, smokes the jar on 127.0.0.1, and publishes nothing. Section 3 has the workflow rules, section 4 says how to verify before the first GitHub run, and section 6 is the review checklist. The development, review, release and lead role files now name the guide.

This repository has no .github/ yet. Please schedule a slice that adds both workflows plus .github/dependabot.yml. The operator suggests a low tier with the delegated plan-lock: CI configuration only, no product behaviour change. Put it in mission 02's next wave so it does not disturb wave 1, and keep it disjoint from the src/ territories in flight.

Notes for the slice:
- Seats cannot push. The first GitHub run happens when the human pushes the stacked pull request branch that carries the merge, and the operator opens the pull request. PROOF.md records that run as pending, and the operator adds its URL once it is green.
- Action SHAs are resolved with git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/<owner>/<action> on a Claude seat, because Codex seats have no network.
- CI runs ./gradlew check after actions/setup-java with Temurin 21. scripts/gw pins a Homebrew JDK path and is for local seats only.

Close this item with no-follow-on once the slice is scheduled, naming its id.
summary: HUMAN DECISION: CI/CD in GitHub Actions on every repository (D14) — guide docs/guidance/ci-cd.md; schedule a low-tier slice adding ci.yml, cd.yml and dependabot.yml
